2609.14913.title: Externalizing Requirement-to-Repair Artifacts as Observable Traces for LLM-Based Program Repair
2609.14913.paper_summary: Repository-level repair requires not only correct patches but also inspectable records that explain how issue requirements are translated into code changes and post-edit evidence. We contribute THEMIS, a stage-aware repair workflow that externalizes this requirement-to-repair process through semantic interpretation, a runtime requirement-code graph, graph-derived Developer guidance, retained repair rationale and patches, and post-edit audit records. A retrospective audit of 300 SWE-bench Lite cases demonstrates that these artifacts provide broad support for cross-stage inspection: a complete Developer rationale is available for 288 cases, and 214 cases (71.3%) retain a complete audited field set connecting the selected stages. The retained records further enable systematic measurement of cross-stage correspondence: target symbols recur in 62.6% of Developer rationales and in 62.8% of patches, rising to 75.8% when related symbols are included. In a paired 100-case comparison, the relational workflow resolves 19 cases versus 9 for the direct same-input condition; because the two conditions also differ in Analyzer output, graph-derived distillation, and Judge records, we report this as preliminary, workflow-level evidence rather than a causal effect of the graph component. Together, these results show that THEMIS makes otherwise implicit requirement-to-repair transitions inspectable, enabling systematic examination of how repair decisions persist, align, and evolve across stages.
2609.14913.paper_summary_zh: 儲存庫層級的修復不僅需要正確的修補程式，還需要可檢查的記錄，解釋問題需求如何轉化為代碼變更和後編輯證據。<lb/>我們貢獻了 THEMIS，一個階段感知的修復工作流程，通過語義解釋、運行時需求-代碼圖、圖派生的開發者指導、保留的修復理由和修補程式，以及後編輯審計記錄，將這一需求到修復的過程外部化。<lb/>對 300 個 SWE-bench Lite 案例的回顧性審計顯示，這些文檔為跨階段檢查提供了廣泛的支持：288 個案例提供了完整的開發者理由，214 個案例（71.3%）保留了連接所選階段的完整審計字段集。<lb/>保留的記錄進一步使得系統化測量跨階段對應成為可能：目標符號在 62.6% 的開發者理由和 62.8% 的修補程式中重現，當相關符號被納入時，這一比例上升至 75.8%。<lb/>在一個配對的 100 案例比較中，關聯工作流程解決了 19 個案例，而直接相同輸入條件下則解決了 9 個；因為這兩種條件在分析器輸出、圖派生的提煉和評審記錄上也有所不同，我們將此報告為初步的工作流程層級證據，而不是圖組件的因果效應。<lb/>綜合這些結果顯示，THEMIS使得原本隱含的需求到修復的轉變變得可檢查，從而使得系統化檢查修復決策如何在各階段持續、對齊和演變成為可能。
